name: Dark Mode Design

sources.title: Dark Mode Design — curated gallery of dark-mode websites; 'Submit a site' is a mailto:hello@darkmodedesign.com?subject=Site%20Submission; cards link out to the featured sites

requirements: The site must genuinely use a dark-mode design — this is a single-theme design showcase
Submission is email: hello@darkmodedesign.com with subject 'Site Submission' (the 'Submit a site' link is a mailto)
Curated — the maintainer picks what appears; each card links out to the site
Sponsored slots exist (a Mobbin card marked 'Sponsored')
workflow: Email hello@darkmodedesign.com with subject 'Site Submission' and the URL
If selected, a screenshot card appears in the gallery linking to your site
watchFor: Single-theme curation — light-themed products don't belong
Niche value: a design-community backlink, not a launch audience
countsAsLive: A card for the site appears in the Dark Mode Design gallery
